details: Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs) have recorded a six-day streak of outflows, while Spot Ethereum ETFs have seen 10 consecutive days of withdrawals, totaling $216 million in the past week. Despite this, Bitcoin's price saw a modest 0.6% increase. Some altcoins, such as Hyperliquid's HYPE, experienced significant gains, indicating a shift in investor focus amid broader market pressure influenced by rising Treasury yields and geopolitical uncertainty.
title: Bitcoin & Ethereum ETFs Face Significant Outflows, Altcoins Show Selective Gains

details: Nasdaq PHLX has received conditional approval from the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) to list cash-settled Bitcoin index options, pending final approval from the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC). This development is seen as a crucial step towards the mainstream adoption of digital assets by traditional financial institutions, offering investors more regulated avenues for exposure to Bitcoin.
title: Nasdaq PHLX Gains Conditional Approval for Bitcoin Options

details: More than $655 million worth of crypto tokens from several major projects are scheduled to be unlocked in the final week of May 2026. This includes Huma Finance (HUMA) with 458.75 million tokens ($11.64 million) on May 26, Plasma (XPL) with 88.89 million tokens ($7.24 million) on May 25, and Sahara AI (SAHARA) with 132.93 million tokens on May 26. Such unlocks can significantly impact market liquidity and price volatility for the affected assets.
title: Over $655M in Crypto Tokens Set for Unlock This Week

details: The Federal Reserve is reportedly considering opening its direct settlement rails to cryptocurrency firms. This potential move could further integrate crypto into the traditional financial system, despite warnings from banks regarding possible liquidity risks. Such a development would represent a significant step towards legitimizing and streamlining financial operations for crypto entities.
title: Federal Reserve May Open Direct Settlement for Crypto Firms

details: Brazil has successfully integrated a crypto ETF into its core market infrastructure, achieving a level of market plumbing that Wall Street and other major financial hubs are still actively pursuing. This move highlights Brazil's progressive stance on cryptocurrency adoption and its efforts to provide regulated investment vehicles within its financial system.
title: Brazil Integrates Crypto ETF into Market Structure
